admin: Discounts > Create (Amount off products, code) > Applies to > Specific collections > search field
adminSteps: Pick 'Specific collections' in the Applies to select; focus the 'Search collections' input (input.focus()). The wrapper gains Polaris-TextField--focus. Focused box-shadow of the backdrop: rgba(0,0,0,.04) 0 2px 3px -1px, rgba(0,0,0,.04) 0 3px 4px -1.5px, rgba(0,0,0,.04) 0 4px 5px -2px, rgb(80,131,240) 0 0 0 1px, rgba(53,115,246,.06) 0 0 0 3px, rgba(53,115,246,.06) 0 4px 20px 2px, rgba(53,115,246,.05) 0 0 8px 1px inset. Unfocused: rgba(0,0,0,.04) 0 2px 3px -1px, rgba(0,0,0,.04) 0 3px 4px -1.5px, rgba(0,0,0,.13) 0 0 0 1px. The probe prints only shadow yes/none. Hover not measured.
